snippet.title: Pilot Rudder VR - Launch Trailer [VR, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift]
snippet.description:
Launch trailer for Pilot Rudder VR, a virtual reality arcade flying experience where you take loads of passengers all around the world while facing several challenges. The game is being developed by GuraShop and will be released for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift on August 7, 2018. You can find more information, as well as reviews and ratings here: https://vrgamecritic.com/game/pilot-rudder-vr
